about.title: About PlantCare AI
about.subtitle: Your Comprehensive Plant Health Guide
about.feature1_desc: Our advanced AI models are trained on millions of leaf images to provide lightning-fast identification of diseases. Within seconds of uploading a photo, you receive a detailed report on what's affecting your plant.
about.feature2_desc: We support a wide range of crops and ornamental plants. Our database is constantly updated with new diseases and treatment protocols, ensuring you always have access to the latest horticultural science.
about.feature3_desc: We prioritize organic and environmentally friendly treatment recommendations. By identifying diseases early and precisely, we help you reduce the unnecessary use of broad-spectrum chemicals, protecting your soil and local ecosystem.
about.feature4_desc: Preventing crop failure is the best way to save money. By catching issues early, you can take action before the damage spreads, saving your investment and ensuring a bountiful harvest.
